name: Qualtrics
summary: Qualtrics is an experience-management platform (surveys, CX, EX/Engagement). Its agent surface is a first-party MCP at one per-brand URL (rewritten 2026-11-17; it replaced per-API servers) whose tools set up surveys, contacts, mailing lists, samples, libraries and distributions under the user's OAuth login; read:survey_responses covers only schema and filters. Its theme engines (Text iQ, Text Analytics) are UI features reachable by no MCP scope or API endpoint, so hr.summarize-engagement-feedback is empty.

payments.notes: qualtrics.com/pricing (200, read 2026-11-16) shows no currency figure and routes to Request demo; quote-based/enterprise. The listed MCP surface requires the purchased API feature and a Brand-Administrator OAuth client, so it is not reachable on a free survey account. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless and not probed: the MCP endpoint is per-brand (e.g. my-brand.iad1.qualtrics.com/API/mcp), not a fixed public URL. Access is OAuth 2.0 via a client a Brand Administrator creates (each call runs as the signed-in user), or a one-hour client-credentials Bearer token.
